{{Quote|The kids devoured their cakes in short order, and I heard the lead female of the Wookiee gang softly growl the melody to the traditional hymn "Tree of Life." |Gyylghrard, shortly before the Life Day massacre.|<ref name="his" />}}
This '''unidentified prisoner''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who was sent to the [[Kessel prison|Imperial Correctional Facility]] a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Even though she was young for Wookiee standards, she became the leader of the group comprised of other young Wookiee prisoners.<ref name="his" />

During an improvised [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] celebration in the prison, which was arranged by the old Wookiee prisoner [[Gyylghrard]], the female Wookiee led the others in singing the traditional hymn [[Tree of Life/Legends|Tree of Life]]. When the part came where the prisoners ignited their candles with their issued [[sparkstick]]s, the Wookiees used the incendiary device to overload their electronic shackles instead. Free of their restraints, the young Wookiees, joined by the other prisoners, staged a riot against the guards. They managed to reach the prison's landing bays before a squad of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] blocked their escape, bringing them down in a hail of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire. None of the young prisoners survived in what was called the [[Life Day massacre]].<ref name="his" />
